comment: CI wall-clock budgets for the X86 legalizer regression suite. Measured values were recorded on the reference machine named below; the budgets are contract thresholds, not measurements.

hard_limit_rule: Exceeding 10s requires reducing the witness or moving tests to nightly plus an approver entry; the budget itself must not be raised.
